definitions.explanation: the moment when the sun appears above the horizon; also the time at which this occurs

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{出|で}を{見|み}に{山|やま}に{登|のぼ}った。
examples.english: I climbed the mountain to see the sunrise.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{日|ひ}の{出|で}は6{時|じ}23{分|ふん}です。
{初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で}を{拝|おが}むために{早起|はやお}きした。
examples.english: I woke up early to view the first sunrise of the year.

notes:
JAPANESE CULTURE:
{初|はつ}{日|ひ}の{出|で} (first sunrise of the new year) is traditionally considered auspicious in Japan. Many people travel to mountains, beaches, or temples to watch the first sunrise on January 1st.

ANTONYM:
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り / {日没|にちぼつ} (sunset)

RELATED WORDS:
- {夜明|よあ}け / {明|あ}け{方|がた} (dawn - before sunrise)
- {朝日|あさひ} (morning sun)
- {日|ひ}の{光|ひかり} (sunlight)
